::: {#sol-finite-difference-cost}

$P + 1$: one at the current [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter), and one more for each [parameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) nudged.
[Backpropagation](#def-backpropagation) gets all $P$ derivatives from one forward pass and one backward pass,
and each backward step costs a small multiple of its forward step:
a matrix product forward becomes two matrix products backward,
as in @sol-linear-param-grad and @sol-linear-input-grad,
so the two passes together cost about three forward passes.

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
def mean_loss():
    return loss_fn(mlp(x_train), y_train)

start = time.perf_counter()
for repeat in range(20):
    mlp.zero_grad()
    mean_loss().backward()
backprop_seconds = (time.perf_counter() - start) / 20

start = time.perf_counter()
with torch.no_grad():
    base = mean_loss()
    w = second.weight
    estimate = torch.zeros_like(w)
    for j in range(w.shape[0]):
        for k in range(w.shape[1]):
            w[j, k] += 1e-3
            estimate[j, k] = (mean_loss() - base) / 1e-3
            w[j, k] -= 1e-3
difference_seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
fd_gap = (estimate - second.weight.grad).abs().max().item()
print(backprop_seconds, difference_seconds, fd_gap)
```

One forward and backward pass over the [training set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-training-set) took `r sprintf("%.2f", 1000 * py$backprop_seconds)` milliseconds,
for every parameter of the [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network).
Finite differences for only the `r py$second$weight$numel()` entries of $\matr{W}_2$ took `r sprintf("%.0f", 1000 * py$difference_seconds)` milliseconds,
`r sprintf("%.0f", py$difference_seconds / py$backprop_seconds)` times as long,
and agree with backpropagation only to within `r format(py$fd_gap, digits = 2)`, since a finite difference is an approximation.
Timings vary from run to run; the ratio grows with the number of [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter).

:::
